about-me.name: Ravi Akhouri
about-me.summary: Results-driven Angular UI Developer with experience designing, developing, and improving complex frontend applications while using AI-driven solutions to enhance productivity & user experience. In pursuit of challenging opportunities in front-end development with ability in Angular, responsive UI design in a dynamic environment.

responsibilities: Worked on ECCT (Energy Component Configuration Tool) and CME (Class Model Editor), Excel-like applications used for configuration and data management workflows.
Enhanced the ECCT user experience by redesigning the UI and consolidating functionality from multiple pages into a single-page, tab-based interface, improving usability and navigation efficiency.
Delivered multiple bug fixes, enhancements, and feature improvements across both ECCT and CME, contributing to increased application stability and user satisfaction.
Received a 'Good Job' appreciation token in recognition of successfully resolving multiple issues and delivering quality improvements.
Contributed to EC (Energy Component), a legacy application built using Java and PL/SQL, by delivering multiple user stories and enhancements.

Leveraged Agentic AI workflows to accelerate development tasks, including implementing Java business logic changes, creating and updating PL/SQL triggers, and managing database changes through Flyway migrations.
